# Neck tail

Type: Material | Internal ID: NeckTail | Source: Neck | Usage: Cauldron, ,, Cooking station, ,, Mead ketill | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Neck tail is a basic food obtained from killing Necks. It can be cooked on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station to obtain Grilled neck tail or Coal if overcooked. It may also be used for a Cauldron recipe or Mead ketill recipe.

## Availability

• Creature: Neck | 0 Star: 70% | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

### Crafting

• Grilled neck tail
• Coal, if left on a Cooking station for too long
• Minced meat sauce
• Mead base: Poison resistance
Grilled neck tail cannot be used to craft recipes using Neck tail as ingredient.

Categorias: Materials, Food
